hold_reason: Refund for order 194 (amount_cents 5972) is requested in the batch but is not in the refunds table. list_refunds returned only order 192 (3148) and order 193 (9581). W2 also reported only those two as applied. No payouts recorded. Needs human review of the missing order 194 refund before paying.
